subject: Re: [simmer-devel] naming and numbering batches from different trajectories

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] naming and numbering batches from different trajectories
parts:
2017-11-13 17:26 GMT+01:00 Shereen Ashraf <sashra...@gmail.com>:
> Hi,
>
> I have 2 separate trajectories generating arrivals that are batched in
> batches of 10. I have assigned a name for batches coming from each
> trajectory to distinguish between batches coming from each trajectory.
>
> i.e for trajectory A, batch(10, timeout=0, permanent=FALSE,
> name="trajectoryA")
> trajectory B, batch(10, timeout=0, permanent=FALSE, name="trajectoryB")
>
> however in the output it does not show the batches numbered. How do I make
> the batches numbered but also be able to distinguish between batches from
> trajA and batches from trajB?

This is not possible. As I said in a previous email (copy&paste from there),

[When you use the "name" argument] you lose the
numbers, i.e., the distinction among batches under the same name.
However, note that batch identifiers are merely informational and only
appear in logs or debugging information (verbose=TRUE): they are NOT
monitored. Batches are "fictitious" entities, so only arrivals are
monitored. I suggest you to rely on them, not on batches.

Iñaki
